acceptedValueShapes: Calendar: Google or Microsoft calendar object containing events with nested start and end timeStamp/dateTime values
Calendar: iCalendar object containing events with summary, startTimestamp, and endTimestamp, either directly or under calendar.events
Feed: current Wallboard feed channel containing items with media, attachments, publishDate, or categories
Feed: legacy RSS parser output under feed.entries, RSS channel.item, or a processed item array

behavior.unbound: render synthetic preview data only in the preview fixture; real bound empty sources render the configured empty state
behavior.boundEmpty: calendar-only, feed-only, and both-empty states each render intentionally without replacing missing customer data
behavior.invalidRows: skip cancelled or malformed calendar events, strip rich feed text to plain text, and ignore unsafe or broken media
behavior.ordering: feature the active or next calendar program first; use a fresh announcement sorted newest-first as support; rotate extra programs without resetting on independent feed updates
